provenance.source: Poem texts are standard public-domain Tang poems (Traditional script) as commonly printed in school anthologies; metadata written by the project. Only jingyesi has playable content (content/poems); the rest are 'coming-soon' stubs with no readings, units or translations.
provenance.notes: Text variants exist for some of these poems; the school-anthology form is used. Stub entries are metadata only and are not validated against the poem schema.

entries.text: 床前明月光疑是地上霜舉頭望明月低頭思故鄉
春眠不覺曉處處聞啼鳥夜來風雨聲花落知多少
白日依山盡黃河入海流欲窮千里目更上一層樓
紅豆生南國春來發幾枝願君多採擷此物最相思
朝辭白帝彩雲間千里江陵一日還兩岸猿聲啼不住輕舟已過萬重山
